    _validate_hierarchy(self)

    """
    Each version SHOULD have an inventory up to that point.
    Also keep a record of any content digests different from those in the root inventory
    so that we can also check them when validating the content.

    """
    if not version_dirs:

        )
        return

    root_inventory = Inventory(self.root_dir)
    self.digests = [
        digest
        for digest in root_inventory.digests
        if not digest.endswith("_inventory.csv")
    ]

    for version in version_dirs:
        version_inventory_path = f"{version}/inventory.csv"
        version_inventory = Inventory(version_inventory_path)
        if not version_inventory:
            self.validation_report.add_error(
                f"Version {version} inventory does not exist or is empty."
            )

        digests = set(version_inventory.digests) - set(root_inventory.digests)
        if digests:
            self.validation_report.add_warning(
                f"Version {version} has the following content digests different from the root inventory: {', '.join(digests)}"
            )
            self.digests += digests

    self.validation_report.summary.should_check_content = bool(self.digests)
